text:
Predicates:
Player(x) ::: x is a football player.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
NickName(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
Loan(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Club(x) ::: x is a football club.
SameClub(x, y) ::: x is a football club along with y.

Premises:
Player(ailton) ∧ BornIn(ailton, 1995) ∧ NickName(ailton, Ailton) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton.
Player(ailton) ∧ Loan(ailton, braga) ::: Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga.
Player(ailtonSilva) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ∧ Club(nautico) ∧ Club(braga) ∧ SameClub(nautico, braga) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Nautico. Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
Club(fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.

Conclusion:
¬∃x (PlaysFor(x, nautico) ∧ Brazillian(x)) ::: No one playing for Nautico is Brazilian.
